cells.label: fact

items.text: Edward Jones identifies the evolving financial services industry and generational wealth transfer, including changing client expectations and demographics, as a force affecting its ability to compete and adapt its business model.
items.quote: The Partnership's continued ability to compete and adapt its business model may be adversely impacted by the evolving financial services industry and generational wealth transfer, including changing client expectations for expanded product offerings and technology needs, and changing client demographics, preferences and values.

items.text: Edward Jones says its net new assets decline reflects higher asset outflows, which it attributes in part to an aging client base and generational wealth transfers outside the firm.
items.quote: Net new assets decreased by 10% compared to the second quarter of 2024, continuing a downward trend which can be attributed to higher asset outflows. These outflows are impacted by a variety of factors, including, without limitation, an aging client base and generational wealth transfers outside the firm

items.text: Edward Jones attributes the year-to-date decline in net new assets to elevated outflows influenced by, among other factors, an aging client base and generational wealth transfers outside the firm.
items.quote: The outflows relative to the prior-year period continue an increasing downward trend influenced by several factors, including an aging client base, generational wealth transfers outside the firm, macroeconomic volatility, inflationary pressures, and shifts in consumer spending.

items.text: Edward Jones describes initiatives aimed at new client segments, including High Net Worth, Workplace, Financial Planning Services, and a new digital platform focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.
items.quote: These initiatives also include targeting new clients: High Net Worth, focused on attracting and serving high net worth clients through expanded advice, planning, products and services across multiple service models; Workplace, which connects local business owners and their employees with financial solutions through their workplace; and a new digital platform, focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.

items.text: Edward Jones says it addresses strategic risks, most notably competition for clients and personnel in light of generational wealth transfer and changing client demographics, through initiatives to deliver enhanced value for current and potential clients.
items.quote: The Partnership seeks to address its strategic risks, most notably competition for clients and personnel in light of the evolving financial services industry and generational wealth transfer, changing client demographics, preferences and values, technology, artificial intelligence, and regulatory changes, through its initiatives

items.text: Edward Jones ended the second quarter of 2025 with 20,309 financial advisors, with financial advisor attrition of 6.4% due primarily to an increase in retirements.
items.quote: The Partnership ended the second quarter with 20,309 financial advisors. Financial advisor attrition increased to 6.4% primarily due to an increase in retirements, consistent with industry trends.

items.text: Edward Jones took a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken with the stated intention of integrating Quicken's personal financial management capabilities into Edward Jones, while noting it is still determining the deployment strategy.
items.quote: Edward Jones announced that they have taken a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken , with an explicit intention that the investment is a step towards integrating Quicken's personal financial management capabilities more directly into Edward Jones

items.text: Edward Jones is building a technology platform integrated into its advisor workstation covering the workplace retirement plan lifecycle, currently in beta with a group of advisors, with the prospecting module expected to go live to the broader network early next year.
items.quote: The technology platform, which will be integrated into Edward Jones’ advisor workstation, will cover the entire workplace retirement plan lifecycle, from prospecting to plan servicing. Edward Jones is currently in beta with a group of advisors for the platform’s prospecting module

cells.reason: Passages state Edward Jones's disclosures about generational wealth transfer as a risk and outflow driver and describe its stated initiatives (segment targeting, digital platform for Next Generation investors, Quicken stake, workplace retirement platform); no single figure of preparation is asked, so these attributed statements are facts.
